name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
title: Trishakti Industries Ltd - 531279 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Crane rental capex-led expansion: FY26 capex INR 210 crore vs INR 100 crore guidance, but receivables near 200 days, subvention income of INR 4.58 crore inflates EBITDA, and payables of INR 159 crore sit off the debt line.

utilisation.quote: we scaled our fleet from just eight machines in FY25 -- FY24 to over 140 machines today with near full utilization

capex.quote: we significantly outperformed our CapEx guidance of INR 100 crores in FY26 by deploying INR 210 crores of fresh CapEx during this year

triggers.label: FY26 capex INR 210 cr vs INR 100 cr guided
triggers.quote: significantly outperformed our CapEx guidance of INR 100 crores in FY26 by deploying INR 210 crores of fresh CapEx

triggers.label: Trade receivables ~200 days
triggers.quote: our trade receivable cycleis about 200 days, is because there is a very small amount of a family settlement

triggers.label: Subvention INR 4.58 cr in EBITDA
triggers.quote: Our reported EBITDA includes INR 4.58 crores of subvention income classified under other income.

triggers.label: Order book INR 60 cr+ for FY27
triggers.quote: currently, our order book is INR 60 crores and above for FY27, financial year

guidance.value: INR 62.5 crore (per slide; management says FY26 INR 33 crore is actual)
guidance.quote: the INR 62 crores which we are talking about, currently our ARR from the last month is approximately INR 5 crores
crane hiring revenue growth in INR lakhs 62.5 crores and then INR 95 crores in FY28

guidance.value: around 1.5, blended over time; keep below 2x
guidance.quote: this debt to equity of around 1.5, eventually, we will blend it out to be 1.5
targeted ROC of 22-25%, which is our strategy to continue to scale up

prior_guidance_check.quote: we significantly outperformed our CapEx guidance of INR 100 crores in FY26 by deploying INR 210 crores
we have always given that FY26, we would have done a net top line of INR 20 crores to INR 22 crores
But in FY27, it will be normalized. That I can assure you.
